acceptanceCriteria: Each item is specified with requirement IDs before implementation.
MCP tools are read-only, proven by test.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Later roadmap from the panel: change-level per-hunk coverage reporting, ARIA-based locator proposals, flake quarantine with retained evidence, read-only MCP tools for catalog/obligations/prove reports, and snapshotting a proven compiled scenario into the hosted suite as the bridge toward retirement (V2).
title: CCE V1/V2: per-hunk coverage, ARIA proposals, flake quarantine, MCP read tools, snapshot into the hosted suite
